Hannah / team — quick ballpark based on the inputs. Assumptions: 75 peak concurrent users, average total prompt+response ~720 tokens (120+600), 5% at 2,120 tokens. Model recommendation: 13B top-tier open checkpoint quantized to 4-bit (for cost) or 8-bit for tighter latency SLAs. H100 preferred for 2k-token tails; A100 P4d-style fleet can work if we shard carefully.

Rough footprint (preliminary):
- Median/steady: 1 x H100 (or 4 x A100 with optimized batching) can sustain ~250 QPS at ~100–140ms/token with 0.8s median latency for 600-token responses using dynamic batching and prefix KV caching.
- Peak with tails: to keep 95th <=220ms/token we should target 2 x H100 (or 8 x A100 equivalent) to avoid queuing on 2k-token requests.
- Autoscale policy: base cluster 1 H100, burst to 2 H100 at a CPU/KV cache saturated threshold (e.g., queue length > 20 requests / 5s).

Notes on optimizations:
- Enable KV cache for repeat summaries to reduce repeated decode cost (~10–15% improvement).
- Use mixed quantization: 4-bit for most layers, FP16 for attention outputs in tail-sensitive endpoints.
- Suggest 256–512GB of shared RAM for KV cache and pre-warming checkpoint cache if on dedicated VPC.

I'll carve a more detailed cost/throughput calc after Marissa's load modeling (gives us QPS distribution).

— Rishi

Alex — thanks again for the worksheet and prompts. Quick summary and next steps from our sizing intake:

Summary (preliminary):
- Typical traffic: ~1.2k DAU, peak concurrency ~75, business hours concentrated.
- Latency guidance: to meet 95th percentile latency targets we recommend a Dedicated cluster that starts with 1 x H100-equivalent for baseline and autoscaled to 2 x H100 for peak/tail events. With the configuration below you should see median response latencies in the ~700–900ms range for 600-token outputs and 95th percentile remain under ~1.5s (meets your SLA targets).

Recommended configuration (initial):
- Model: 13B open checkpoint; mixed 4-bit quantization with attention outputs FP16 for tail sensitivity.
- Serving hardware: 1x H100-equivalent baseline; autoscale to 2x H100 for sustained peak or >20 queued requests.
- KV cache: 512GB shared; aggressive prefix caching for repeated patient summaries.
- Network: Private VPC with 10Gbps egress baseline; ensure peering with your EHR system for low-latency retrieval.
- Cost controls: rate limiting on exported summary endpoints, and optional queue-based graceful degradation to the 8-bit variant when in burst.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will produce a short footprint sheet (vCPU/GPU counts, expected QPS) and a cost estimate for baseline vs peak.
2) Rishi will send a short ops playbook for autoscale thresholds and KV sizing.
3) If Procurement is ready, we can start a short SOW and security questionnaire; we have the SOC2 artifacts ready to share.

I'll wait for Marissa and Rishi's numbers and then schedule a 30-min follow-up with your team next week.
